name: Poll with add-option
use_when: the group has to choose one of several options and wants to vote
options were already mentioned in the chat (places, movies, dates, colors)
dont_use_when: they want Muse to pick at random (use wheel)
a yes or no headcount for one plan (use lock)
many options to narrow down head to head (use bracket)
guarantees: one vote per person per option; single choice moves your vote
a vote changes only the voter's own vote; an added option comes last with its adder's vote
at most 8 options of 1-40 characters, unique labels
only people in the chat vote; a leaver's votes go, a late joiner can vote at once

title.description: Card title, a plain question, e.g. 'Where should we eat?'

options.description: Options already mentioned in the chat, 0 to 8, short

suggested.description: The labels from options that you proposed and nobody in the chat said; empty when every option was said in the chat

multi.description: true if each person can vote for several options

allowAdd.description: true if people can add options
